G^{N,0}_{0,N}(z | -- ; b_1,...,b_N) – the gamma-chain shape (s = 1/2).

Source: R/meijer.R
g_gamma_chain.Rd

Dies at large z (carries e^{-z}): pass underflow_above (mirroring meijer.UNDERFLOW_Z in the Python original) to short-circuit to exactly 0 past a threshold where the true value is confidently negligible, rather than attempting the direct series there (see .g_core_raw's docs for why that regime is numerically treacherous, not just slow).

Usage

g_gamma_chain(z, b, prec_bits = DEFAULT_PREC_BITS, underflow_above = NULL)

Arguments

z

Positive numeric scalar.

b

Numeric vector of length N (the lower/denominator parameters).

prec_bits

Working precision in bits (default ~38 decimal digits).

underflow_above

Optional threshold; z at or above it returns 0.

Value

An mpfr number.
